description: "Turn an ambiguous feature idea into an implementation-ready spec with assumptions, architecture impact, risks, acceptance criteria, and phased tasks."
argument-hint: "Describe the feature idea, business goal, and known constraints"
agent: "agent"
---

Use the workflow in [Idea To Implementation Spec](../skills/dejan-idea-to-implementation-spec/SKILL.md) as the source of truth.

Produce an implementation-ready spec package:
- restate the problem and define success
- build a known-versus-unknown map
- make explicit assumptions with confidence labels instead of blocking on missing information
- propose architecture options when uncertainty is high and recommend one with trade-offs
- include scope, non-goals, architecture and design, data and API changes, edge cases, security and privacy, observability, milestones, risks, acceptance criteria, and execution starter tasks

Prefer the templates and references linked from the skill file.
